newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzania on target to obtain donor cash.
newsitem.headline: Tanzania on target to obtain donor cash.

text.p: Tanzania is on target to receive more than $500 million in donor assistance, an International Monetary Fund (IMF) official said on Friday.

Festus Osunsade, IMF senior representative in Tanzania, told Reuters the first instalment would come as early as October with the granting of $234 million under the IMF soft-loans Enhanced Structural Adjustment Facility (ESAF).
That would be followed by a $100 million World Bank loan and $220 million in debt relief from the so-called Paris Club of mainly Western donors, Osunsade added.

An IMF mission to Tanzania in October will make a decision on whether the government has complied with recommendations to cut official corruption, cut the civil service, and encourage fiscal discipline -- items that have delayed donor funds in the last year.
